## C++ Multiple Pointer Declaration

In C++, `*` applies to the **variable**, not the entire declaration.

```cpp
ListNode* a, b, c;
```

means:

```cpp
ListNode* a;  // pointer
ListNode  b;  // object
ListNode  c;  // object
```

So this is **wrong** if all should be pointers:

```cpp
ListNode* left = nullptr, right = nullptr;
```

Use:

```cpp
ListNode* left = nullptr;
ListNode* right = nullptr;
```

Or:

```cpp
ListNode *left = nullptr, *right = nullptr;
```

### Rule to remember

> **Every pointer variable needs its own `*`.**
